name: get_entity_relationships
author: hprebar
title: Entity relationships
description: Derives relationships between entities from their plan geometry, naming both ends by AEC type: intersect (boundaries cross or one lies inside the other), connected (an end of a run reaches the other entity within the connection tolerance — beam to column, pipe to fitting; the gap in mm and a confidence that falls with the gap), near (within maxDistance), inside / contains, touching, and the axis relations aligned / parallel / perpendicular on the main axes of linear members (valueMm carries a gap/distance/offset, angleDeg the angle between axes). Source and target are filters or handles; omit the target to relate the source set to itself. Use this for 'which beams sit on this column', 'is this pipe connected to the equipment', 'what is inside this room', 'are these walls aligned'. Read-only.

filter.description: Which entities to consider. Types, layers and block names accept AutoCAD wildcards (* and ?) and comma lists; handles short-circuit everything else.

types.description: DXF names: LINE, LWPOLYLINE, POLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, ELLIPSE, SPLINE, HATCH, SOLID, INSERT (block reference), TEXT, MTEXT, DIMENSION, LEADER, MULTILEADER…

colors.description: ACI index as text ("1"), "ByLayer", "ByBlock" or a true-colour name

blockNames.description: Block definition names or wildcards (INSERT entities only)

textContains.description: Case-insensitive substring of the text / dimension text / block attribute values

handles.description: Exact entity handles (hex); when given, the other criteria only narrow this list

visibleOnly.description: Skip invisible entities and entities on off/frozen layers

space.description: model (default), current (the active layout), all, or a layout name

handles.description: Source entities by handle instead of a filter

target.description: Which entities to consider. Types, layers and block names accept AutoCAD wildcards (* and ?) and comma lists; handles short-circuit everything else.

relations.description: Relations to test; omit for intersect, connected, inside, contains, touching

maxDistance.description: mm — search radius of the near relation (default 100)

tolerance.description: Overrides of the geometry tolerances in millimetres (angles in degrees); omitted members keep the defaults shown.

pointEquality.description: Two points are the same point

endpointConnection.description: Endpoints this close were meant to meet (gaps, connectivity, touches)

collinearity.description: Offset within which segments count as collinear/overlapping

parallelAngle.description: Degrees within which directions count as parallel or perpendicular

duplicate.description: Vertex distance within which two entities are near-duplicates

tinySegment.description: Segments shorter than this are reported as tiny

roomGap.description: An open polyline whose ends are this close was probably meant to be closed

ruleSet.description: Classification rule set used to name the ends (default / user / file name)

limit.description: Maximum relationships returned (count tells the total that hold)

maxCandidates.description: Cap on entities read per set
